title: ComparePanes
responsibility: Renders paired revision content with side-bound headings, roles, gaps and metadata slots.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.panes
inputs.description: Required side contexts produced by comparisonPanes; each retains its own commit, content and evidence gap.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.visible
inputs.description: Optional visible side: both by default, before or after. Labels keep their original side in a single-side view.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.className
inputs.description: Optional owner layout classes. Defaults to ex-panes; the app stylesheet controls the responsive column layout.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.paneClass
inputs.description: Optional classes on each side frame. Defaults to ex-pane.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.framed
inputs.description: True by default to draw each side frame. False lets specialized image/audio/detail children own their semantic frame.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.headings
inputs.description: True by default to show the side heading and revision role; false preserves a specialized child heading.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.contents
inputs.description: False by default. True uses display: contents so an existing parent arranges the side boxes.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.gap
inputs.description: Optional gap-rendering slot for that side. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, using EmptyState with the recorded gap.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.children
inputs.description: Required content slot receiving exactly one ComparisonPane, including its own value and identity. Rendering errors propagate.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.heading
inputs.description: Optional heading slot receiving that same side. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, using its shared heading and role.

inputs.name: ComparePanes.details
inputs.description: Optional provenance/details slot receiving that same side. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting extra details.

outputs.name: ComparePanes
outputs.description: Rendered comparison content composed from the selected side contexts and the supplied snippets.

errors.name: Content slot error
errors.description: Errors from children, heading, details or gap snippets propagate; the comparison does not swap or suppress side data.
